description:
Modify the Chinook database schema and data to segment customers based on their music taste diversity. 

1. Open the SQL tool (Tools > SQL) in LibreOffice Base.
2. Add a new column named 'Segment' (VARCHAR) to the 'Customer' table.
3. Populate this column: Set 'Segment' to 'Eclectic' for customers who have purchased tracks from 4 or more distinct genres. Set 'Segment' to 'Casual' for all other customers.
4. Save the database file to persist changes.

Note: You will need to join Invoice, InvoiceLine, and Track tables to count distinct genres per customer.
